verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official start-parameter docs describe a headless mode for using the application without a UI when controlled by external clients. They also document batch CLI operations such as --convert-to, --cat (which implies --headless) and --print-to-file, plus UNO acceptor strings for API control. A community user independently reports running it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats. Missing for 10: explicit first-party guidance or examples for CI pipelines (such as an official container image or CI setup docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface. This special mode can be used when the application is controlled by external clients via the API.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
